description: Write and billing answer decoding (sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.4, 5.5, 6.2 and 7.2). Build a server client with the key ent_test_conformance_server_key, maxRetries 0 and an empty cache, make call on customer(call.customer) through a fake transport that answers status, headers and body (JSON text), and compare the decoded answer with outcome, or the ApiError raised. call is check(feature), plans(), recordUsage(feature, amount, { idempotencyKey }), subscribe(plan, { period, returnUrl, idempotencyKey }), cancel({ addOn, idempotencyKey }), undoPendingChange({ idempotencyKey }), setPlan(plan, { period, until, reason, actor, idempotencyKey }), setAddOn(addOn, { quantity, idempotencyKey }), grant(feature, { value, days, reason, actor, idempotencyKey }), revokeGrant(grantId, { idempotencyKey }), billingPortal({ returnUrl }) or syncBilling(), passing only the arguments call holds. Header names are case-insensitive, and replayed is true only when the answer carries Idempotent-Replayed: true. outcome holds the fields an SDK exposes, in the language's naming: for a check, entitled and upgrades (each upgrade's plan key, name, move, action and reason); for plans(), held (each held plan's plan as { id, key, name, kind }, product as { key, name } or null, version (a whole number or null), byDefault, period as { key, label } or null, renewsAt, pending as null, { type: move, plan } or { type: cancel, movingTo } (movingTo { id, key, name } or null), and billedBy) and options (each option's plan as { id, key, name, kind, description, default }, product as { key, name } or null, from as { id, key, name } or null, move, action, reason, when, periods as [{ key, label }], impact as [{ kind, text }], and skus as [{ period, connector, ids, price }], with period { key, label } or null, connector its raw string, ids the connector's ids by field, and price { amount, currency, interval, intervalCount, tax } or null); for recordUsage, the UsageResult's outcome, refusal, id, holdId, mode, amount, meterChange, overBy, late, occurredAt, expiresAt, reportedAs, entitled, used, remaining, held, upgrades and replayed; for subscribe, the SubscribeStep's next, with url for pay, billedBy for manage, and the PlanChange fields with replayed for done, while an unknown step holds only its raw next; for cancel, undoPendingChange, setPlan and setAddOn, the PlanChange's product ({ key, name } or null), plan ({ id, key, name } or null), quantity, effective, at, until, changed and replayed; for grant and revokeGrant, the GrantChange's grant (its id, feature, until and revokedAt) and replayed; for billingPortal, url; for syncBilling, changed. An enum value this version does not know is { "unknown": raw }, null is none, and a decoded instant is { "instant", "epochMillis" }. A 2xx body that does not decode, a field of another JSON type included, fails with the ApiError invalid_response, and its outcome gives the error's fields as errors.json does: kind, status, code, message, requestId, retryAfterSeconds, idempotencyKey (the key the call sent, or null) and payment.

cases.why: A check the customer is not entitled to lists an upgrade with its plan, name, move upgrade, action buy and a null reason.

cases.name: check-upgrade-to-contact

cases.why: An unavailable upgrade keeps its reason for the developer.

cases.name: plans-held-plan-billed-by-unknown-store

cases.name: plans-period-label-renamed

cases.name: plans-pending-move

cases.name: plans-pending-cancel
cases.why: A held plan with a cancel booked for renewal carries the default plan it leads to.

cases.name: record-usage-recorded
cases.why: A recorded report answers its outcome, mode, amount, meter change and meter, with replayed false since the answer has no Idempotent-Replayed.

cases.name: record-usage-replayed
cases.why: A repeated key answers duplicate with Idempotent-Replayed: true, so replayed is true and the meter did not move.

cases.name: record-usage-refused-over-allowance
cases.why: A gated report past the allowance answers refused with its refusal and upgrades, as an answer, not an error.

cases.name: record-usage-unknown-outcome-and-source
cases.why: An outcome and a reportedAs the SDK does not know are kept as their raw strings.

cases.name: subscribe-done-now
cases.why: A done step made now carries the PlanChange fields, with replayed false.

cases.name: subscribe-done-at-renewal
cases.why: A done step booked for renewal has effective renewal and at the instant it takes effect.

cases.name: subscribe-done-replayed
cases.why: replayed rides on the done step: Idempotent-Replayed: true makes it true.

cases.name: subscribe-pay
cases.why: A pay step carries the url of the provider's page.

cases.name: subscribe-pay-with-replayed-header
cases.why: Only the done step carries replayed, so a pay step answered with Idempotent-Replayed: true holds its url alone.

cases.name: subscribe-confirming
cases.why: A confirming step holds nothing more: the provider is still confirming the payment.

cases.name: subscribe-manage-apple
cases.why: A manage step names the store that bills the product.

cases.name: subscribe-manage-google
cases.why: A manage step can name Google Play.

cases.name: subscribe-manage-unknown-store
cases.why: A store the SDK does not know is kept as its raw string.

cases.name: subscribe-unknown-next
cases.why: A step the SDK does not know is kept as an unknown case with its raw next.

cases.name: subscribe-done-unknown-effective
cases.why: An effective value the SDK does not know is kept as its raw string.

cases.name: subscribe-step-with-unknown-fields
cases.why: Unknown fields in a step are ignored.

cases.name: subscribe-done-changed-a-string
cases.why: A quoted boolean is another JSON type, so the step does not decode and the call fails with invalid_response.

cases.name: subscribe-next-a-number
cases.why: A next that is a number, not a string, does not decode.

cases.name: cancel-at-renewal
cases.why: A cancel at renewal names the plan it leaves the customer on, when it takes effect and changed true.

cases.name: cancel-nothing-to-cancel
cases.why: A cancel with nothing to cancel answers changed false, not an error.

cases.name: cancel-add-on-now
cases.why: Removing an add-on now answers quantity 0, and plan none since nothing is left in its place.

cases.name: undo-pending-change
cases.why: Undoing a booked change keeps the customer on their plan now, with changed true.

cases.name: undo-nothing-pending
cases.why: An undo with nothing pending answers changed false.

cases.name: set-plan-with-until
cases.why: A company change with until carries the instant the customer returns to the default plan.

cases.name: set-plan-replayed
cases.why: A setPlan answered with Idempotent-Replayed: true has replayed true: the write changed nothing this time.

cases.name: set-plan-replayed-header-false
cases.why: replayed is true only for Idempotent-Replayed: true, so false leaves it false.

cases.name: set-plan-already-held
cases.why: The plan already held, with the same period, billing and until, answers changed false.

cases.name: set-add-on-quantity
cases.why: setAddOn answers the add-on and its quantity after the change.

cases.name: set-add-on-removed
cases.why: setAddOn with quantity 0 removes the add-on, answering quantity 0 and plan none.

cases.name: plan-change-quantity-a-string
cases.why: A quoted number is another JSON type, so the PlanChange does not decode.
